name: Nature
overview: Scripture reveals that nature is a powerful testimony to God's creative authority and sustaining power, as He alone made the heavens, the earth, and all living creatures within them (Nehemiah 9:6). The natural world, including the beasts and birds, serves as a teacher of divine wisdom (Job 12:7), while the heavens and the firmament vividly display the glory and handiwork of God (Psalms 8:3; 19:1). Creation itself is called to praise and rejoice in the Lord, underscoring the intentional design and ongoing praise of the Creator through the natural order (Psalms 69:34; 96:11).
